identity: A woman around thirty. A low, soft alto with a little breath in it, plain North American accent. She is cold, tired, and talking quietly to herself in an empty place; never theatrical, never narrating.

steady.direction: Calm and even, talking herself into calm.
steady.impression: Okay. The kettle's on, the door's shut, the lantern's lit. Everything is where it should be. I'm fine.

warm.direction: Tender and fond, almost smiling, a catch at the end.
warm.impression: You always do this. You show up late with snow in your hair and you think a smile fixes it. ...It does, a bit.

hushed.direction: Barely above a whisper, close and careful, as if something might hear.
hushed.impression: Shh. Don't move. If we stay very still, maybe it won't hear us breathing.

shaken.direction: Unsteady, breath short, words coming a little too fast.
shaken.impression: I don't... I don't understand, it was right here, I put it right here, I know I did.

breaking.direction: On the edge of tears, voice cracking, pauses where it gives out.
breaking.impression: I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. I didn't mean it, I never meant any of it, please come back.

resolve.direction: Low and determined, jaw set, each word placed.
resolve.impression: No. I'm not stopping. Not now. I'll walk until there's nowhere left to walk.

calling.direction: Shouting as loud as she can into a strong wind, straining, desperate.
calling.impression: Can you hear me? Hello? I'm over here! Over here!

numb.direction: Flat, slow and far away, the feeling gone out of her voice.
numb.impression: It doesn't hurt any more. That's the strange part. Nothing hurts. It's all very far away.

bitter.direction: Hurt turned into anger, clipped, a little too loud, then quiet.
bitter.impression: Oh, of course. Of course you did. You always get to leave, and I always get to clean up after.

pleading.direction: Small and begging, bargaining with something that isn't listening.
pleading.impression: Please. I'll do anything. Just this once. Just let her be all right, and I won't ask for anything else.

wry.direction: Dark humour under her breath, half a laugh, to keep from crying.
wry.impression: Well. That went about as well as everything else today. Brilliant. Really.

remembering.direction: Soft and slow, looking at something far away, a smile that hurts.
remembering.impression: We used to skate on the lake when it froze. She'd hold my hands and go backwards, laughing, the whole way across.

panicked.direction: Fast and breathless, words tripping over each other.
panicked.impression: No no no, where is it, where did it go, I can't, I can't breathe, where is it...

spent.direction: Completely out of breath, gasping between the words.
spent.impression: Wait... wait... I just... I need... one second. Okay. Okay.
